name: tashkeela-functions
description: Cloud Functions for Tashkeela: poll rules, promotions, reminders and the WhatsApp webhook.

scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-tashkeela --only firestore,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib/integration/flow.test.js lib/integration/rules.test.js lib/integration/storage.test.js"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-tashkeela --only functions,firestore,auth
